async def print_property_certificate(ctx):
    """查询贷款用途的有／无产权证明并触发打印"""
    page = ctx.page
    
    # Navigate to the dashboard start page
    await page.goto("https://jxd.ghhzrzy.tj.gov.cn/personal/iebdc.html?isKstb#/newHome/newDashboard", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
    
    # Click "不动产登记资料查询" to ensure the sidebar menu is visible
    await page.locator('text=不动产登记资料查询').first.click()
    
    # Click "有/无产权证明" (With/Without Property Certificate) in the sidebar menu
    await page.get_by_text("有/无产权证明").click()
    
    # Select "贷款" (Loan) as the query purpose
    # There are two inputs with placeholder "请选择". The second one (index 1) is for "*查询目的" (Query Purpose).
    await page.locator('input[placeholder="请选择"]').nth(1).click()
    await page.get_by_role('listitem').filter(has_text='贷款').click()
    
    # Click the "查询" (Query) button to execute the query
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="查询").click()
    
    # Wait for results to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    # Click the "打印证明" (Print Certificate) button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="打印证明").click()
    
    return {"status": "success", "message": "已查询贷款用途的有/无产权证明，并点击了打印证明按钮"}
description: 查询贷款用途的有／无产权证明并触发打印。该工具会从首页导航，先点击“不动产登记资料查询”展开菜单，然后点击“有/无产权证明”，选择贷款用途，执行查询，最后点击打印证明按钮。

status.description: 执行状态，成功返回 success

risk_notice: 该工具会触发网页查询和打印操作，可能产生实际的打印请求。
